column1: # Tarleaks ERP — the app sheet: what each app needs, and what it costs to run.
# Read by install.sh / install.ps1 and ./tarleaks apps. Choose apps with
#   ./install.sh --apps hr,crm        (Windows: .\install.ps1 -Apps hr,crm)
# and everything they NEED is installed with them; nothing else runs.
# Columns (separated by spaces; `-` means none; `name` is the rest of the line):
#   app         the licence name of the app
#   kind        platform = always runs (the ERP's own machinery)
#               base     = always runs (every workspace holds these apps)
#               app      = runs only when chosen, or needed by a chosen app
#               addon    = an editor, not an app: runs next to the apps named
#                          in `needs` while editors are on (./tarleaks editors
#                          on|off); cannot be chosen by name
#   unit        the service (container) that runs it; two apps may share one
#   needs       apps it cannot work without (installed automatically). Mirrors
#               shared::license::requires in the product; a release that
#               changes it ships a new copy of this file. For an addon: the
#               apps it runs for (any one of them).
#   works_with  apps that add to it when you also have them (never automatic)
#   aliases     other words accepted by --apps
#   ram_mb      memory to plan for the unit, in MB, at light use (one company,
#               tens of users). 0 = shares the unit of another app.
#   name        what the app is called on screen
# app              kind      unit                needs                                        works_with                                         aliases                         ram_mb name
